svg.text: Seats and hats — shown in the mode indicator, switched in one click (house style; design §2.3 / §2.5)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
ONE indicator: run mode · seat · hat (§2.3);
a click opens this menu — never an action (R-3061)
a hat the seat does not allow stays visible, greyed
the seat changes only to a seat this host allows
leaving a hat keeps the view; Back to my view
restores the one you had before (R-260)
Esc = one level out: a tool inside the hat → the hat → Observe.
Shortcuts are the action ids' keys (E14) — shown, never hidden.
C — the director is playing; the user moved the camera
You have the camera — the director retakes it at its next shot
untick: the director never takes the camera back
